el.Raíz rioplatense y latinoamericana, impr: Rioplatense and Latin American roots, improvisation and timbral exploration.
el.Marcos Cifuentes & Marimbismos combina s: Marcos Cifuentes & Marimbismos blends sounds rooted in the Río de la Plata region and Latin America with improvisation and timbral exploration. Marimba, double bass, percussion and voices shape both songs and instrumental passages.
el.Contrabajista y compositor. Reconocido c: Double bassist and composer. Recognized as a leading figure in the cultural life of Berazategui, his hometown. He was a founding member of the Orquesta Académica del Teatro Colón. His first album, Canciones de Contrabando, was chosen as album of the month by the Club del Disco de Buenos Aires. He has worked with artists such as Palo Pandolfo and Marta Gómez. He is principal double bass of the Banda Sinfónica de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires.
el.Destacado marimbista de Buenos Aires. Be: One of Buenos Aires' leading marimba players. A recipient of an FNA grant, he has published two books: Marimba meets Gardel and Nuevos arreglos de tango para dúo de marimba y vibráfono. He was a member of the OSN and is currently a percussionist with the Orquesta de Tango de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires.
el.Oriundo de Trenque Lauquen, se formó en: Born in Trenque Lauquen, he trained at the Conservatorio Manuel de Falla and the EMPA. He has a solid career in folk music, having worked with artists such as María Creuza, Ángela Irene and Santaires, among others. He is the drummer of the Orquesta del Tango de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires.
